description: Get Ondo OHLC, dividends, shares-multiplier history and per-chain token supply. Family availability and source clocks are explicit. Valid windows: 1min/1day, 5min/1day, 15min/1day, 1hour/1month, 4hour/1month, 12hour/3month, or 1day with 3month, 6month, 1year, all. Defaults to 1hour/1month. Underlying dividend yield is a decimal, not token distribution yield. Supply is in token units, not USD.

symbol.description: Exact case-sensitive Ondo token symbol, for example SPYon; obtain it from list_ondo_assets.

name: get_ondo_asset_data
